r0010.doc: bank the most right now: take the option with the highest immediate pot

r0011.doc: preserve capacity: take the option that consumes the least irreversible capacity, ties to immediate pot

r0012.doc: one-ply lookahead: take the option whose single next draw has the best greedy expected pot

r0013.doc: null circuit: take the first option in enumeration order, reading nothing about the state

r0014.doc: spend capacity only when it pays: take the option maximising pot gain per unit capacity consumed

r0003.doc: myopic one-step rule: stop iff P(death) * pot >= E[immediate gain]. Cycle 002's transferring circuit.

r0004.doc: floor: never bank voluntarily, ride to forced end or death

r0005.doc: floor: bank at the first opportunity

r0007.doc: survival rule: stop once the chance of surviving one more draw falls below one half

r0015.doc: two-ply myopic: stop iff continuing for TWO draws under greedy play has negative expected change
